price.question: Why is it priced at {{registration.currency}}{{registration.price}} when it's worth {{registration.currency}}{{registration.originalPrice}}?
price.answer: We keep the price low so any student can join. It is the full course, not a trailer: there are no hidden fees and no upsell. This one payment covers all 3 LIVE days, the editable worksheets, WhatsApp community access and your completion certificate.

noUpsell.question: Will you try to sell me another course at the end?
noUpsell.answer: No. This is the full course: every technique from all 3 days, the worksheets, the certificate and the WhatsApp community are included in the one payment. There is no sales pitch at the end of the sessions.
